newsitem.title: USA: B.V.R. says to buy Nexus warrants.
newsitem.headline: B.V.R. says to buy Nexus warrants.

text.p: B.V.R. Technologies Ltd said Tuesday it plans to exercise up to 990,332 series C warrants to buy ordinary shares of Nexus Telecommunications Systems Limited.
The warrants have an exercise price of $3.50 per share.
BVR said the funds generated to Nexus through the exercising of the warrants will bring that company into compliance with Nasdaq listing requirements.
Nexus was set to be delisted April 17.
Nexus will issue to BVR and any other holder of series C warrants one five-year series E warrant for every two series C warrants to be exercised by holders no later than August 31.
The series E warrants may be exercised at a price of $5.357 per share.

BVR will determine the number of series C warrants it will exercise based on the relationship between the funds Nexus will get from a recently announced deal with Global Wireless Communications LP and the equity it needs to comply with the NASDAQ listing requirements.
In March, Nexus announced a deal in which Global will buy for $4.5 million warrants exercisable into three million comman shars.
B.V.R. makes and sells training and simulation systems for land, sea, and air military uses. Nexus makes and sells low-energy wireless communications systems.
